fib: ______ are defined as micro-organisms (including bacteria, viruses, rickettsiae, parasites, fungi) and other agents, such as prions, which can cause disease in humans or animals.
Pathogens are defined as micro-organisms (including bacteria, viruses, rickettsiae, parasites, fungi) and other agents, such as prions, which can cause disease in humans or animals.
______ is the final stage of the hazardous waste management system.
Disposal is the final stage of the hazardous waste management system.
______ is any substance, whether solid, liquid or gas, that may cause harm to your health.
Introduction A hazardous substance is any substance, whether solid, liquid or gas, that may cause harm to your health.
______ are those that are ignitable, corrosive, reactive, toxic, or all of these.
Substances considered hazardous are those that are ignitable, corrosive, reactive, toxic, or all of these.
______ can be defined as broad group of chemicals capable of causing harm to plants and animals including humans.
Toxic substances can be defined as broad group of chemicals capable of causing harm to plants and animals including humans.
______ is a naturally radioactive chemical, a gas that arises from transformations occurring in underlying rocks and soil around the world as natural radioactive uranium decays.
Radon is a naturally radioactive chemical, a gas that arises from transformations occurring in underlying rocks and soil around the world as natural radioactive uranium decays.
